answer_1.quote: The effectiveness of OPTIMUS has been demonstrated with extensive experiments on language modeling, dialog response generation, text style transfer and low-resource language understanding.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences such as dialog responses, style‑transferred reviews, and other conditioned text

answer_2.quote: We use perplexity (PPL) for language modeling, BLEU for generation quality, G-score (geometric mean of Accuracy and BLEU), Self‑BLEU for diversity, and also report Active units (AU) and Mutual Information (MI) as representation metrics.
